description: Modoc County, CA – Today, California State Assembly candidate Heather Hadwick announces an endorsement from Siskiyou County Supervisor Brandon Criss. Criss is a fourth-generation Siskiyou County farmer who assumed office as a Modoc Supervisor in 2013.
